content:
alex: Quick check — planning to enable the feature flag rollout/multi_region_failover for an EU canary tonight at 02:00 UTC. Need ops + oncall sign-off.

alex: Scope: 5% of EU sessions (session-based hashing), stickiness TTL = 30s, fallback_region = na, fallback_model = redwood-v2-small. Circuit-breaker threshold = 10% error within 1m. No DB schema changes.

maria: +1 from infra. What's the proposed verification plan? :eyes:

jin: oncall ok with window. suggest starting at 1% for 10m then 5% if stable.

sam: agree w jin. Also add telemetry check for per-region latency and kv-cache hitrate.

elena: FYI: console routing metrics just got 1m granularity so should be fine.

luis: Can you paste the ffctl commands? I'll be ready to flip back if we see regressions.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance notice queued for 2026-08-20 02:00 UTC — reminder will ping channel 30m prior.

alex: Commands/procedure:

```
# enable canary
ffctl set rollout/multi_region_failover --enabled true \
  --scope eu_canary --percent 1 --sticky true --sticky_ttl 30s \
  --fallback_region na --fallback_model redwood-v2-small

# promote to 5% after checks
ffctl update rollout/multi_region_failover --percent 5

# rollback
ffctl set rollout/multi_region_failover --enabled false
```

alex: Quick verification steps:
1) Watch dashboard: eu -> na reroute rate, per-region p99 latency, model fallback rate.
2) Run `curl -H "x-session-id: test-<id>" https://api.redwood.ai/generate` across EU test sessions (we have a test pool)
3) If errors > 10% or p99 increases > 200ms, run rollback and open incident.

maria: Add an automated alert: eu_failover_rate > 1% for 5m OR eu_p99_latency increase > 200ms -> page oncall.

jin: I'll add the alert and a short runbook. @sam can you own the rollback if triggered?

sam: Yep, I'll handle rollback within 5m and post a short postmortem if we had to.

elena: Small note: sticky TTL 30s may still keep sessions on failed region for a bit; consider 10s if we need faster recovery.

alex: Good point — prefer 30s for UX, but we can drop to 10s in second wave if needed. Starting low percent mitigates risk.

luis: all set from my side. I'll be in the channel at rollout and will run the curl checks.

alex: Thanks all — I'll kick off at 02:00 UTC. Will post progress updates here. :rocket:
